TEXT: [FI] That night ―― I'm on the phone with Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I am really sorry for what my sister did to you 
earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What about you, are you okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You didn't fight with your sister after you reached 
home, did you?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ahh... no problems here.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] After all, I haven't seen her since.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh? Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Yes. I already made preparations to exact 
vengeance for my boyfriend, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] The ruffian doesn't seem to be coming home 
anytime soon.
[FI] By ruffian, she means...

[FI] It seems that Kaori's staying the night somewhere 
else instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I bet she probably just met an old friend and she's 
busy hanging out with them. Leaving me behind.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...She's always been like that.

[FI] This is the first time "Saori Bajeena" has acted so 
harsh.

[FI] She has quite the grudge... she must have been 
bottling her negative emotions up.

[FI] Just like... how Kirino and I acted towards each 
other in the past.
[FI] Saori's older sister, Makishima Kaori, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmmmm.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] What's with that groan, Kyousuke-shi?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] That's not the attitude you should be taking while 
on the phone with your cute girlfriend, you know~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, my bad. Lost myself in my thoughts for a while 
there.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hohoh, planning stuff out for our next date?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Nah, just my usual bad habit.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Woah! So that means, will everyone's older brother, 
Kyousuke-shi, meddle with someone again?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's my girlfriend. You know me so well.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Fufu, but of course. It's about my lovable 
boyfriend, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] That part of you, truly that part of you is exactly 
what made me fall for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...That so? Well then, when I'm meddling with 
someone else... could you lend me a hand?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...How reliable of you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll give you the full details tomorrow then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Okay, then the meetup... oh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Oh nothing, I was just in a chat while talking to you 
on the phone...
[FI] She's very dexterous.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I was talking about hanging out with Kiririn-shi and 
Kuroneko-shi tomorrow.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Um... Kyousuke-shi, I just made plans with them just 
now, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I get what you're saying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Let's all go somewhere, together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Also, we should take the chance to tell them about 
us dating.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] You really... can say it like it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Certainly. Let's do just that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.
